lines.t: In the quiet of my childhood, I once heard your gentle call
Before I learned the fears of failing before the shadows fall
Now grown I carry burdens and I hunger to recall
That first embrace of wonder when trust was all in all
When longing shakes my refuge and desperation tears the night
I find you waiting silently
Beyond my strength and pride
So break me open
Bring me love
Let humility begin
Confession on my lips
I yearn to be undone again
To strive, receive, accept your love
To choose your perfect will
Restore me to the child you saw
Whose heart was yours to fill
There were days I wandered far
Content to walk unknown
Believing I was safest when I faced this world alone
But every longing, every cry still led me to your side
Each honest word, a plea for grace I never could disguise
Remind me of the laughter, the light in younger eyes
How you rejoiced to hold me, how love had no disguise
Let desperation teach me, let humility teach me
Make me bold, just seek you still
To know you, to abide
Break me open, bring me low
Let humanity begin
Confession on my lips
I yearn to be undone again
To strive, receive, accept your love
To choose your perfect will
Restore me to the child I was
When all I knew was still
So I offer up my striving
My longing and regret
May repentance bear its fruit in love
Not soon to forget
You long to share with children
The joy of ages past
Prepare my heart for wonder
And hold me home at last
Teach me to remember the place where hope began
To abide within your mercy and grow into your plan
Thank you.
Thanks for watching!
